main_turf.bias_notes: Left-handed (Anti-clockwise). A unique, tight, near-circular track where runners are on the turn almost continuously. Features the shortest home straight in Britain (only 239 yards). Generates the strongest inside draw and on-pace bias in European racing. Front-runners ('E') and box-seat stalkers ('P') dominate, while deep closers ('Swoopers') face near-impossible task due to lack of stretch room and traffic congestion.
main_turf.post_bias: In 5f, 5.5f, and 6f sprints, Stalls 1 through 4 hold an overwhelming advantage (winning 60%+ of large-field handicaps). High draws (8+) face a massive penalty as running wide on continuous turns burns excessive energy. In 7f to 1m2f races, low draws saving ground along the inside rail remain essential.

handicapping_angles.extreme_low_draw_and_leader_lock: Chester is the ultimate 'Draw + Gate Speed' course. Heavily upgrade horses drawn in Stalls 1-4 with proven early speed ('E'). Heavily downgrade wide-drawn hold-up horses, even those with superior speed figures.
handicapping_angles.the_roodee_balance_test: Chester's tight, circular turns favor small, nimble, athletic horses over large, long-striding, bulky gallopers. Look for horses that corner cleanly and have proven winning form on tight, left-handed circuits.
handicapping_angles.chester_may_festival_class_spike: During the high-profile May Festival (Chester Cup, Chester Vase, Ormonde, Dee Stakes), elite Tier 1 stables (Aidan O'Brien, Charlie Appleby, Andrew Balding, John Gosden) target key Derby/Oaks trials. Upgrade high-class pattern horses dropping into local feature events.
handicapping_angles.soft_ground_bias_dilution: On Good to Firm turf, the inside rail acts as an absolute conveyor belt. On Soft or Heavy ground, the inside rail can become chopped up, prompting jockeys to steer 2-3 paths wide in the short straight, slightly tempering the low-draw lock.
handicapping_angles.uk_handicap_weight_penalty: In British Official Rating (OR) Handicaps (Class 2 to Class 5), top weights carrying 138 lbs+ (62.5kg+) face a strict penalty over Chester's tight turns (1kg = ~1 length). In Group / Listed WFA trials (Vase, Dee, Ormonde), prioritize pure class and peak Racing Post Ratings (RPR).
